password.description: 10 to 72 characters, not only whitespace, not the same as the email (AUTH-5).

token.description: The token from the invitation link's fragment (after `#`). Sent only in the body.

ApiError.description: Error body. Clients choose the text they show by `code`; `message` is a default text for a `code` they do not know.

code.description: Stable error key. See docs/integrate/conventions.md for the list.

fields.description: Present only when the error is about specific fields (400 `INVALID_INPUT`).

commentId.description: The comment it belongs to; null for a file on the issue itself.

fileName.description: Cleared to null when the attachment is deleted (COM-7, ATT-5).

id.description: Hard to guess, but not a permission check (ATT-7).

internal.description: Internal comments do not exist for customers (CMT-2).

code.description: 2 to 10 capital letters and digits. Unique, never changes.

internal.description: An internal comment, hidden from customers. Public when left out.

code.description: 2 to 10 capital letters and digits, unique. Cannot be changed later.

companyCodes.description: Codes of the companies a customer joins. At least one for `CUSTOMER`; left out or empty for staff.

lastErrorKind.description: Kind of the last error, for example `CONNECTION_REFUSED`; never the error text.

recipientAccountId.description: The receiving account of an email; null for a webhook.

code.description: Stable field error key, for example `TOO_LONG`.

field.description: Name of the request field or query parameter.

inviteLink.description: Shown once; the token is in the fragment after `#`.
The invitation link, only when SMTP is not configured; shown once. `null` when the invitation email is sent.

version.description: Goes up by 1 on every change to the issue (S0-AC-45).

readAt.description: When the caller marked it read.

companies.description: The companies a customer was invited to; `[]` for staff.

expired.description: The current link is past its 7 days.

email.description: Leading and trailing whitespace and case are ignored.

info.description: The agent console: `/api/console/**` on the console host, and `/api/public/**`. Conventions: docs/integrate/conventions.md.
info.title: popdesk console API

get.description: Every account, newest first (C-10). `role` narrows it, for example to pick an agent to assign (C-9).
All companies for admins, assigned ones for agents (S0-AC-32), in code order.

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `name` or `legalName` empty or over 100, `code` not 2 to 10 capital letters and digits (`INVALID_FORMAT`).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such company, or the caller cannot see it.
`NOT_FOUND`: no such company, or the caller cannot see it.

put.description: The agent, invited ones included, sees the company's issues from the next request. Assigning again is 200 too (S0-AC-31).

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: the account is not an agent (field `accountId` `UNKNOWN_VALUE`). `COMPANY_NOT_ACTIVE`: the company is `ARCHIVED`.

put.summary: Assign an agent to a company

get.description: Customers who belong to the company, invited ones included, in name order (C-9).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such company, or the caller cannot see it.

get.summary: Accounts that have not accepted yet

post.description: Creates an `INVITED` account and queues the invitation email (S0-AC-33). A customer joins the given companies. Without SMTP the response carries the link instead, once. The response has `Cache-Control: no-store` (S0-AC-101).

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `email` malformed or over 100, `name` empty or over 50, `role` unknown, `companyCodes` empty for a customer (`REQUIRED`), given for staff (`NOT_ALLOWED`), or naming a company that does not exist or is not `ACTIVE` (`UNKNOWN_VALUE`) (S0-AC-34).

post.description: Only without SMTP. Makes a new token, so the previous link stops working, and returns the link once (S0-AC-38). The response has `Cache-Control: no-store` (S0-AC-101).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: SMTP is configured (S0-AC-39), or no `INVITED` account has this ID.

post.summary: Make a new invitation link to copy

get.description: All issues of assigned companies for agents, all issues for admins, newest first (S0-AC-47).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such issue, or the caller cannot see it, for example after being unassigned (COM-1, PROJ-4).

get.description: Files on the issue and on all its comments, oldest first. Deleted attachments stay as traces (`deleted`).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such issue, or the caller cannot see it.

post.description: Attaches a file to the issue, or to the caller's own comment with `commentId` (S0-AC-56). A file on an internal comment counts only against the team quota (S0-AC-57).

commentId.description: Attach to this comment of the caller instead of the issue.

400.description: `FILE_EMPTY`, `FILE_TOO_LARGE` (over 10 MB), `ISSUE_ATTACHMENTS_TOO_LARGE` (public attachments of the issue over 50 MB), `ATTACHMENT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` (team quota), `INVALID_INPUT` (field `file` `TOO_LONG`: name over 255; field `commentId` `UNKNOWN_VALUE`: not the caller's comment on this issue) (S0-AC-57, S0-AC-58). `ISSUE_CLOSED`.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such issue, or the caller cannot see it.

413.description: `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`: the request is over the upload limit.

503.description: `SERVER_BUSY`: 16 uploads are running; try again after `Retry-After` (S0-AC-99).

delete.description: The uploader or an admin may delete. The list keeps a trace (S0-AC-61, COM-7).

403.description: `FORBIDDEN`: an agent who did not upload it. `CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID`.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: one identical response for an unknown ID, an issue the caller cannot see, an attachment of another issue, and a pending or deleted attachment (S0-AC-102).

get.description: Always `Content-Disposition: attachment` and `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` (S0-AC-59). Takes `Range` requests.

206.description: Part of the file, for a `Range` request.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: one identical response for an unknown ID, an issue the caller cannot see, an attachment of another issue, and a pending or deleted attachment (S0-AC-102).

503.description: `SERVER_BUSY`: 16 downloads are running; try again after `Retry-After` (S0-AC-99).

head.description: The headers `downloadAttachment` would send, without the body.

200.description: The file exists and the caller may download it.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: one identical response for an unknown ID, an issue the caller cannot see, an attachment of another issue, and a pending or deleted attachment (S0-AC-102).

get.description: Public and internal comments, oldest first, with author names (S0-AC-54).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such issue, or the caller cannot see it.

post.description: A public comment emails the reporter and sets the first response time once (S0-AC-46, S0-AC-70). An internal comment is hidden from customers (S0-AC-53).

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `content` empty or over 4,000. `ISSUE_CLOSED`: the issue is closed.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such issue, or the caller cannot see it.

post.summary: Add a public or internal comment

get.description: Also tells whether the session is still valid.
Own items only, newest first (S0-AC-80, INBOX-3).

get.summary: Unread items in the caller's inbox

post.description: Marking a read item again is 204 too.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such item in the caller's inbox.

get.description: Newest first (S0-AC-81). Read only in the first slice.
For mail and webhook: configured or not, last success, queued and failed rows (S0-AC-81). The console also reads `mail.enabled` to decide whether to offer invitation links (C-10).
Sets the readable CSRF cookie before the first request that changes data (sign-in, accepting an invitation). Clients send its value back in a request header.

post.description: Sets the password, makes the account `ACTIVE`, and signs it in to its app (S0-AC-36). The response has `Cache-Control: no-store` (S0-AC-101).

204.description: Accepted and signed in. The session cookie is set.

400.description: `INVITATION_INVALID`: the token is unknown, expired, used, or replaced by a newer one, or the token is sent to the other app's host (a customer's token on the console host, a staff token on the portal host); one body for all (S0-AC-37). `INVALID_INPUT`: the password breaks AUTH-5 (field `password`: `TOO_SHORT`, `TOO_LONG`, `BLANK`, `SAME_AS_EMAIL`).

post.description: Signs in to the app of the host the request came to: customers on the portal host, agents and admins on the console host. Creates a new session (S0-AC-17, S0-AC-21).

204.description: Signed in. The session cookie is set.

401.description: `SIGN_IN_FAILED`: the same body whether the email is unknown, the password is wrong, the account is invited, suspended, or locked, or it belongs to the other app (S0-AC-22, S0-AC-23).

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: more than 20 attempts from one IP address in 60 seconds. `Retry-After` says when to try again (S0-AC-24).

post.description: Deletes the caller's session (S0-AC-27). Succeeds also without a session.
